description: From the date the relinquished property closed: the 45-day identification deadline, the end of the exchange period (day 180 or the tax return due date if that comes first, by filer type and extension), weekend and federal-holiday flags, days left from today, and the last closing date in that year that keeps the full 180 days. Same math as the 1031.help deadline calculator.

extended.description: True if the return for the year of the sale will be extended.

filer.description: Who files the return for the seller: individual (Form 1040), trust (1041), partnership (1065, incl. multi-member LLC), scorp (1120-S), ccorp (1120).

sale_date.description: Date the relinquished property closed (transferred), YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-11-06. For several sales in one exchange, the first closing.

name: exchange_deadlines
title: 1031 exchange 45-day and 180-day deadlines
